title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 06:00 UTC on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日 06:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 06:00 UTC on 23 September. The 06:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 06:59; hour-start 0.00/0Z, hour-end 0.00/0Z). Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-23 04:57 UTC; label 1M; last-180 window from 04:57 UTC). Published-window maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-23 04:41 UTC; label 1M). Window start 2026-09-23 01:59 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 07:00 UTC hour is still incomplete (57 samples through 07:56) and is not used as the main card.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.00（0Z），取樣 2026-09-23 06:00 UTC。06:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 06:59，時段初 0.00／0Z、時段末 0.00／0Z）。近 180 筆最大 0.67（最先見於 2026-09-23 04:57 UTC；標籤 1M；近 180 筆窗自 04:57 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 0.67（最先見於 2026-09-23 04:41 UTC；標籤 1M）。窗起點 2026-09-23 01:59 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。07:00 UTC 時段尚未收滿（至 07:56 僅 57 筆），不作為主卡片。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (06:00 UTC on 23 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 06:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z; the hour ends 0.00/0Z at 06:59. A 0.67/1M excursion remains in the published window (first remaining sample at 2026-09-23 04:41 UTC).

title.en: A magnitude 4.7 earthquake occurred 30 km SE of Khorugh, Tajikistan on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日，塔吉克 Khorugh 東南約 30 公里發生規模 4.7 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.7, depth about 141 km. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.1 (us7000tj4y, 88 km NNW of Uken, Japan).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.7，深度約 141 公里。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.1（us7000tj4y，日本 Uken 西北偏北約 88 公里）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
